messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
Dock Nine hums under your boots.

A shuttle panel hangs open beside a blinking launch timer, and Anika Solen hands you the diagnostic slate.

(Anika Solen) "Nothing glamorous. Find the fault, fix the fault, and do not let the passengers see us sweat."
